create_rotation_matrix: create a 4x4 rotation matrix from an angle, direction vector, and optional pivot point
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a quaternion [w,x,y,z] into a 4x4 homogeneous rotation matrix
convert_euler_angles_to_matrix: convert Euler angles with a specified axis sequence into a 4x4 rotation matrix
decompose_transformation_matrix: decompose a 4x4 transformation matrix into scale, shear, Euler angles, translation, and perspective components
compute_affine_transform_between_point_s: compute an affine transformation matrix that registers one 3D point set to another
